verses.1: A song of ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the mountains— from where will my help come?
verses.2: My help comes from the LORD, the one who made the heavens and the earth.
verses.3: He will not let your foot slip; the one who guards you will not sleep.
verses.4: Indeed, the one who guards Israel does not sleep or slumber.
verses.5: The LORD guards you; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
verses.6: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.7: The LORD will guard you from all evil; he will guard your life.
verses.8: The LORD will guard your going out and your coming in from now and forevermore.

notes:
Notes  
- v. 3: "He will not let your foot slip" is a translation of "אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ," where "לַמּוֹט" is taken as "to slip" rather than "to move." This reading is consistent with the context of divine protection.  
- v. 6: "The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night" reflects the Hebrew's poetic parallelism and the metaphorical protection of the psalmist.
